name: LifePaths
storyline: In 2076, governments have gradually withdrawn and megacorporations control essential services, employment, information and personal data. Every citizen is evaluated through a Civic Index that affects their opportunities and access to society. From birth to death, the player navigates family, education, work, relationships, debt, health and the law. Each decision shapes the character’s future, and its consequences may return several years later. Every playthrough follows a different life.
summary: LifePaths is a browser-based narrative life simulation game. Players live from birth to death in a dystopian 2076, making decisions whose outcomes are determined by their character’s attributes and dice rolls, then narrated by artificial intelligence.
